contribution.label: Contribution
contribution.notes: Each GEOMAGIA50 publication is one contribution; its records are the sites below. Written by the GEOMAGIA data source sync.

id.label: Contribution ID
id.description: Unique FIESTA contribution ID; the GEOMAGIA reference ID

timestamp.label: Activation Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time of contribution activation

reference.label: Reference DOI
reference.description: DOI of the publication, when it has one

citation.label: Citation
citation.description: Short citation, first authors and year

authors.label: Authors
authors.description: Publication authors as GEOMAGIA lists them

magic_link.label: MagIC Link
magic_link.description: Link to the study's MagIC contribution

geomagia_version.label: GEOMAGIA Version
geomagia_version.description: GEOMAGIA50 release the records were read from

sites.label: Sites
sites.description: Archeomagnetic and volcanic site means (GEOMAGIA50 ARCHEODIJ records)
sites.notes: One row per GEOMAGIA UID: age, paleointensity and/or direction with their methods. GEOMAGIA's lookup codes and cross references are resolved to names and citations; the UID is the only GEOMAGIA key kept.

site.label: Site
site.description: GEOMAGIA record UID, the site mean's unique name

site_horizon.label: Site / Horizon
site_horizon.description: Site, feature or horizon within the locality

sample_id.label: Sample Name
sample_id.description: The publication's own name for the sample or site

region_country.label: Region/Country
region_country.description: Country or region of the site
region_country.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's SITE_ID codes through its aa_locations (the GEOMAGIA ID glossary's regions for the CSV) lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

continent.label: Continent
continent.description: Continent of the country or region
continent.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's SITE_ID codes through its aa_locations (the GEOMAGIA ID glossary's regions for the CSV) lookup.

materials.label: Materials
materials.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's MATERIAL_ID codes through its materials lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

specimen_types.label: Specimen Types
specimen_types.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's SPECIMEN_TYPE_ID codes through its specimen_types lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

age.label: Age
age.description: Age in years CE (negative for BCE)

age_min.label: Negative Age Error
age_min.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

age_max.label: Positive Age Error
age_max.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_sigmas.label: Age Number of Sigmas
num_sigmas.description: Number of standard deviations the age errors span
num_sigmas.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

age_error_type.label: Age Error Type
age_error_type.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's AGE_ERROR_TYPE_ID codes through its error_type lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

dating_methods.label: Dating Methods
dating_methods.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's DATING_METHOD_ID codes through its dating_methods lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

num_samples.label: Paleointensity Samples
num_samples.description: Number of samples used for the paleointensity
num_samples.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_meas_spec.label: Paleointensity Specimens Measured
num_meas_spec.description: Number of specimens measured for paleointensity
num_meas_spec.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_acc_spec.label: Paleointensity Specimens Accepted
num_acc_spec.description: Number of specimens accepted in the paleointensity mean
num_acc_spec.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

ba.label: Paleointensity
ba.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

sigma_ba.label: Paleointensity Error
sigma_ba.description: Uncertainty of the mean ancient field intensity
sigma_ba.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

vadm.label: VADM
vadm.description: Virtual axial dipole moment, calculated from the intensity and site latitude as the GEOMAGIA site does

sigma_vadm.label: VADM Error
sigma_vadm.description: VADM uncertainty from the intensity error

vdm.label: VDM
vdm.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

sigma_vdm.label: VDM Error
sigma_vdm.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

pi_methods.label: Paleointensity Methods
pi_methods.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's PI_METHOD_ID codes through its pi_methods lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

alteration_checks.label: Alteration Checks
alteration_checks.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's AC_ID codes through its alteration_monit_corr lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

md_checks.label: Multi-Domain Checks
md_checks.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's MD_CK_ID codes through its md_checks lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

anisotropy_corrections.label: Anisotropy Corrections
anisotropy_corrections.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's AN_CORR_SET_ID codes through its anisotropy_correction lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

anisotropy_use_status.label: Anisotropy Use Status
anisotropy_use_status.description: Whether the anisotropy measurement corrected the intensity or was an assessment only
anisotropy_use_status.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's AN_USE_STATUS_ID codes through its measurement_use_status lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

cooling_rate_corrections.label: Cooling Rate Corrections
cooling_rate_corrections.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's CR_CORR_SET_ID codes through its cooling_rate lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

num_dir_samples.label: Directional Samples
num_dir_samples.description: Number of samples in the directional mean
num_dir_samples.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_dir_spec_collected.label: Directional Specimens Measured
num_dir_spec_collected.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_dir_specimens.label: Directional Specimens Accepted
num_dir_specimens.description: Number of specimens in the directional mean
num_dir_specimens.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

decl.label: Declination
decl.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

incl.label: Inclination
incl.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

alpha_95.label: Alpha 95
alpha_95.description: Fisher 95% confidence cone of the mean direction
alpha_95.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

k.label: Precision Parameter k
k.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

demag_method.label: Demagnetization Method
demag_method.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's DM_METHOD_ID codes through its dm_methods lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

af_step.label: Maximum AF Step
af_step.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

t_step.label: Maximum Thermal Step
t_step.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

dir_analysis.label: Directional Analysis
dir_analysis.description: How the mean direction was calculated
dir_analysis.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's DM_ANALYSIS_ID codes through its dm_analysis lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

num_14c_samples.label: Radiocarbon Samples
num_14c_samples.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calib_14c_age.label: Calibrated Radiocarbon Age
calib_14c_age.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calib_14c_age_sigma_min.label: Calibrated Radiocarbon Negative Error
calib_14c_age_sigma_min.description: Negative error of the published calibrated age
calib_14c_age_sigma_min.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calib_14c_age_sigma_max.label: Calibrated Radiocarbon Positive Error
calib_14c_age_sigma_max.description: Positive error of the published calibrated age
calib_14c_age_sigma_max.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_14c_sigmas.label: Radiocarbon Number of Sigmas
num_14c_sigmas.description: Confidence level of the calibrated radiocarbon age
num_14c_sigmas.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

c14_calib_software.label: Radiocarbon Calibration Software
c14_calib_software.description: Calibration software of the published age
c14_calib_software.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's C14_CALIB_SOFTWARE_ID codes through its 14c_calibration_software lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

c14_calib_dataset.label: Radiocarbon Calibration Dataset
c14_calib_dataset.description: Calibration curve of the published age
c14_calib_dataset.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's C14_CALIB_DATASET_ID codes through its 14c_calibration_dataset lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

calc_calib_14c_age.label: Recalculated Radiocarbon Age
calc_calib_14c_age.description: Calibrated radiocarbon age recalculated by GEOMAGIA
calc_calib_14c_age.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_min.label: Recalculated Radiocarbon Negative Error
calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_min.description: Negative error of the recalculated age
calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_min.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_max.label: Recalculated Radiocarbon Positive Error
calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_max.description: Positive error of the recalculated age
calc_calib_14c_age_sigma_max.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

calc_c14_calib_software.label: Recalculation Software
calc_c14_calib_software.description: Software used to recalculate the age
calc_c14_calib_software.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's CALC_14C_CALIB_SOFTWARE_ID codes through its 14c_calibration_software lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

calc_c14_calib_dataset.label: Recalculation Dataset
calc_c14_calib_dataset.description: Calibration curve used to recalculate the age
calc_c14_calib_dataset.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's CALC_14C_CALIB_DATASET_ID codes through its 14c_calibration_dataset lookup. GEOMAGIA's -1 and 0 codes are written as their names, 'No measurement' and 'Not specified'. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

tot_num_dendro.label: Dendrochronology Samples
tot_num_dendro.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

num_dendro_used.label: Dendrochronology Samples Used
num_dendro_used.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

compilations.label: Compilations
compilations.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's COMP_REF codes through its comp_reference (authors and year; -1, in no compilation, is left out) lookup. A code with no GEOMAGIA lookup entry is written 'Unknown', which fails validation.

superseded_by.label: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Short citation of the publication whose data supersede this record
superseded_by.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's SUPERSEEDED, the superseding reference's ID (0 and -1: not superseded).

superseded_by_doi.label: Superseded By DOI
superseded_by_doi.description: DOI of the superseding publication, when it has one

see_also.label: See Also
see_also.description: Short citations of related GEOMAGIA publications
see_also.notes: Resolved from GEOMAGIA's CROSS_REF_ID, the related references' IDs; a reference GEOMAGIA no longer lists is written 'GEOMAGIA reference n' (n is also its contribution ID).

see_also_doi.label: See Also DOIs
see_also_doi.description: DOIs of the related publications that have one
see_also_doi.notes: A ':' inside a DOI is written %3A, as in a DOI URL, since ':' separates the list's items.

upload_year.label: Upload Year
upload_year.description: Year the record was added to GEOMAGIA
upload_year.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

upload_month.label: Upload Month
upload_month.description: Month the record was added to GEOMAGIA
upload_month.notes: GEOMAGIA's missing-value markers (-1, -999, -9999) are left blank.

uploader.label: Uploader
uploader.description: Who added the record to GEOMAGIA
